_readme: Custom sources: software that is not in winget-pkgs or Homebrew and is read straight from the publisher's own release feeds. Every run of `npm run ingest` / `npm run daily` re-checks each enabled source (scripts/custom.mjs). Each source has an adapter in scripts/sources/<adapter>.mjs that turns the feeds into versions and installers; the `app` block is what the feeds do not say (name, publisher, license, links). Anything in `app` is hand-written from the publisher's own pages. Nothing here is guessed. `app.icon_url` (optional) is the publisher's own icon, fetched by scripts/icons.mjs (PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF or ICO, https only, 400 KB at most).

app.name: CockroachDB
app.summary: CockroachDB — the cloud native, distributed SQL database designed for high availability, effortless scale, and control over data placement.
